summary: HSBC Holdings filed a Form 6-K reporting its ongoing share buy-back programme announced on 5 August 2026. On 31 August 2026, HSBC repurchased 303,600 ordinary shares at a volume-weighted average price of HK$160.4876 per share, for cancellation, through BNP Paribas on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange. Since programme inception, HSBC has repurchased 23,862,614 shares for approximately US$491.5 million. Shares are cancelled, reducing issued share capital and voting rights. The buy-back is on-market for Hong Kong listing rules but off-market under UK Companies Act. Watch for continued daily repurchase disclosures and programme completion.
